sentences.text: His mom says, "Tommy, time to play outside!"
But Tommy says, "No, I want to watch!"
She thinks too much screen time is not good for Tommy.
One day, Tommy's mom has an idea.
She says, "Let’s go to the park!"
He plays for a long time.
His mom says, "Yes! But no more cartoons today."
He likes to play with friends.
